title: Manner and Classification: aszerint, ahogy and oly módon, hogy

sections.title: Classifying by Criteria: 'aszerint, ahogy / hogy'
sections.content: 'Aszerint, ahogy...' (according to how...) and 'aszerint, hogy...' (according to whether / what...) link an action or classification in the main clause to a dynamic criterion in the subordinate clause. Notice the fused postpositional pronoun 'aszerint' (az + szerint).

sections.title: Methodological Precision: 'oly módon, hogy'
sections.content: In scientific descriptions, 'oly módon, hogy...' or 'olyan módon, hogy...' (in such a way that / by means of...) explains the exact manner in which an investigation or intervention is carried out, often highlighting a deliberate methodological safeguard.

sections.title: Analytical Clauses of Manner and Criterion
rows: according to how the reflexes respond
according to which group it belongs to
oly módon, hogy a beteg ébren maradt
in such a way that the patient remained awake
olyan módon végezték a mérést, hogy...
they conducted the measurement in such a way that...

items.spanish: A jelenségeket aszerint osztályozzuk, ahogy a fényre reagálnak.
items.english: We classify the phenomena according to how they react to light.

items.spanish: A professzor oly módon vizsgálta a beteget, hogy közben minden részletet feljegyzett.
items.english: The professor examined the patient in such a way that he noted down every detail meanwhile.

items.spanish: A kezelést aszerint módosítják, hogy milyen gyorsan javul az állapot.
items.english: They modify the treatment according to how quickly the condition improves.

sections.title: B2 Stylistic Notice
sections.content: Using 'oly módon, hogy' instead of simple 'úgy, hogy' immediately elevates a procedural description to formal academic Hungarian.
